_about: The one hand-written thing behind What Came First?. Every puzzle in
games/what-came-first/deck.js is DERIVED from this list by
tools/make-what-came-first.js - so a date corrected here corrects every
puzzle that uses it, and no puzzle can contradict another.
`year` is a signed integer used ONLY for sorting and is never shown.
`display` is what the room reads, and is always hedged, because the year
is not the claim being made - the ORDER is.
The bar for being in this list is not 'we know the date'. It is 'the
ORDER survives the argument'. The Exodus is dated to about 1446 BC or
about 1260 BC depending on who you ask, and it belongs here because
either way it is after Abraham and before David.
_caveats: DEBORAH, GIDEON and SAMSON are not independently dated. Their order is
the order of the book of Judges and the spacing between them is imposed.
That is the ordinary convention for a Bible game and it is what a room
would reason from, but it is narrative order, not archaeology.
THE FLOOD and THE TOWER OF BABEL carry conventional numbers with no
external support. Only their relative position is solid.
THE CREATION has no date at all: a sentinel year for sorting, and 'the
beginning' on the screen. Inventing a number for it would be the one
kind of confident wrong answer this game exists to avoid.
PENTECOST is the only entry whose `year` and `display` disagree: it is
fifty days after THE CROSS, so it sorts as 32 and displays as the same
year. The generator refuses any triple whose three displayed dates are
not distinct, which is what keeps that pair off one screen - two
identical dates beside numbers claiming an order read as a bug.
The Tagalog is a translation of our own labels, not of scripture, so it
needed no licence and no fetched text. Dates hedge with 'mga' rather than
the Latin 'c.', which means nothing to a Filipino reader.

_excluded.why: the man anchors to c. 780 BC, but much scholarship dates the book to the Persian or Hellenistic period, which flips him against Isaiah

_excluded.what: JOEL, OBADIAH, NAHUM, HABAKKUK, ZEPHANIAH, MALACHI
_excluded.why: century argued; several could flip against Isaiah, Jeremiah or Esther
dating spans AD 60-100, which flips against the fall of Jerusalem

_excluded.what: AMOS, HOSEA, MICAH, ELISHA, HEZEKIAH, JOSIAH, EZEKIEL, THE FALL OF SAMARIA, THE KINGDOM DIVIDES
_excluded.why: safe, but all land within 40 years of a better-known neighbour
Esther, Ezra and Nehemiah sit inside 33 years of each other, so only one can be in. Esther was kept as the most recognisable; swapping her for Nehemiah is equally safe
538 BC, one year from Daniel and the lions
both land about 1100 BC, on top of Samson

_excluded.what: THE TEN COMMANDMENTS, THE PASSOVER, THE BURNING BUSH, THE LAST SUPPER, THE RESURRECTION, JESUS IS BAPTIZED, STEPHEN
_excluded.why: same year as an entry already in the list

anchors.label: THE CREATION
anchors.note: Genesis 1; deliberately given no number - the year field is a sort sentinel only

anchors.label: THE FLOOD
anchors.note: Noah's flood; the number is traditional, but the order (after creation, long before Abraham) is not in dispute

anchors.label: THE TOWER OF BABEL
anchors.note: Genesis 11, between the flood and the call of Abraham

anchors.label: ABRAHAM
anchors.note: the call to leave Haran for Canaan

anchors.label: ISAAC
anchors.note: born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age

anchors.label: JACOB
anchors.note: wrestles at Peniel and is renamed Israel

anchors.label: JOSEPH
anchors.note: sold by his brothers and taken into Egypt

anchors.label: SLAVERY IN EGYPT
anchors.note: the new king who did not know Joseph puts Israel under forced labour

anchors.label: MOSES IS BORN
anchors.note: birth, 80 years before the exodus; moves with the exodus date, order unaffected

anchors.label: THE EXODUS
anchors.note: Israel leaves Egypt; early date 1446 vs late date 1260 is argued, but either way it is after Abraham and before David

anchors.label: THE WALLS OF JERICHO
anchors.note: Joshua takes the city, 40 years after the exodus; shifts with the exodus date but never past it

anchors.label: DEBORAH
anchors.note: judges Israel and defeats Sisera; early in the book of Judges

anchors.label: GIDEON
anchors.note: the 300 men against Midian; middle of Judges, after Deborah

anchors.label: SAMSON
anchors.note: his judgeship, last in Judges, in the Philistine era just before the monarchy

anchors.label: SAUL BECOMES KING
anchors.note: anointed by Samuel as Israel's first king

anchors.label: DAVID BECOMES KING
anchors.note: begins to reign after Saul's death

anchors.label: SOLOMON
anchors.note: builds the first temple, in the fourth year of his reign

anchors.label: ELIJAH
anchors.note: the contest with the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel, under Ahab

anchors.label: ISAIAH
anchors.note: his call, in the year King Uzziah died

anchors.label: JEREMIAH
anchors.note: his call, in the thirteenth year of Josiah

anchors.label: THE EXILE TO BABYLON
anchors.note: Jerusalem and the first temple fall to Nebuchadnezzar

anchors.label: DANIEL AND THE LIONS
anchors.note: the lions' den under Darius, just after Babylon falls to Persia

anchors.label: ESTHER
anchors.note: becomes queen to Xerxes (Ahasuerus) of Persia

anchors.label: ALEXANDER THE GREAT
anchors.note: conquers the Persian empire and the Holy Land; the goat of Daniel 8

anchors.label: ROME TAKES JERUSALEM
anchors.note: Pompey enters the city; why Rome rules Judea in the Gospels

anchors.label: JESUS IS BORN
anchors.note: birth in Bethlehem, before Herod's death in 4 BC

anchors.label: JOHN THE BAPTIST
anchors.note: begins preaching in the desert, the fifteenth year of Tiberius

anchors.label: THE CROSS
anchors.note: the crucifixion; AD 30/31/33 are all argued, order never moves

anchors.label: PENTECOST
anchors.note: fifty days after the cross - SAME YEAR; year bumped by one for sorting only

anchors.label: PAUL IS CONVERTED
anchors.note: on the road to Damascus

anchors.label: PAUL WRITES ROMANS
anchors.note: written from Corinth near the end of the third journey

anchors.label: THE FALL OF JERUSALEM
anchors.note: Rome destroys the city and the second temple

anchors.label: JOHN WRITES REVELATION
anchors.note: exiled on Patmos, late in Domitian's reign
